temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, which is uncharacteristic; when Carolyn asks if something is wrong, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff and thanks her for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is normally engaging and that her recent quietness is unusual and possibly concerning, though she does not yet know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn's response confirms she is overwhelmed rather than simply distant, validating Carolyn's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under work and personal stress and may need support; Carolyn should be available but not intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and sympathetic; slightly reassured that Marilyn spoke with her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer a listening ear and check in supportively with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction; when Carolyn says she hopes she did not overstep and shares her own tough times, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she may have overstepped or that Marilyn is upset with her, because Marilyn's curtness felt confusing and hurtful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn's apology and explanation reframe the curtness as caused by a hard week, not by Carolyn's concern or personal rejection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling but appreciates Carolyn's support; Carolyn's attempt to clear the air was appropriate and helpful.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and sympathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear up the misunderstanding, show support, and be patient with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Following their last conversation, Marilyn seemed to respond positively to Carolyn's openness; when Carolyn invites her to a small get-together, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn appreciated her openness and that their friendship is developing; she feels relieved and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn's acceptance confirms she is willing to socialize outside work and invest in the friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in a friendship and open to spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the bond with Marilyn by hosting the gathering and including her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as maintaining professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have a budding friendship outside work, but she also believes Marilyn is keeping a professional distance at work, which makes her feel disappointed and confused.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn's response suggests the distance may have been unintentional or a misunderstanding, and she is open to addressing their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is willing to talk about and improve their collaboration; the work distance may not be personal rejection.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To have a candid conversation about professional expectations and boundaries and improve their working relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; when she proposes teaming up for the new project, Marilyn agrees, says she is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have resolved the work-distance issue and now understand each other's expectations and boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms she wants a closer working partnership and values their improved understanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They have a stronger, more collaborative relationship, and Marilyn is positive about working together on the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
